extracted.name: Philly Cheese Steak Sloppy Joes
extracted.description: Homemade Philly cheese steaks Sloppy-Joe style are quick and easy to make in one skillet and served on whole wheat buns.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir beef in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Add bell peppers, onion, and garlic; saute until beginning to tenderize, about 5 minutes more.

Stir water, cornstarch, bouillon, and Worcestershire sauce together in a bowl. Add to beef mixture in skillet. Cover with a lid and reduce heat to low. Simmer until sauce thickens and veggies are tender, 7 to 10 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Add mozzarella cheese; cover until melted, about 2 minutes. Stir to combine.
Serve beef mixture on buns, Sloppy Joe-style.
